Zhang Qing joined Liangshan with the Mount Erlong group. Wu Song and Lu Zhishen later became outlaws on that Qingzhou mountain and remained in contact with him and his wife. When the three mountain strongholds united to attack Qingzhou and then joined Liangshan, Zhang Qing and Sun Erniang went with them and became chiefs. At the grand assembly he ranked 102nd among the Earthly Fiends as the Earthly Punishment Star and served as an infantry officer. Sun Erniang was one of the three female commanders, making their shared place among Liangshan's Earthly Fiends a notable husband-and-wife story. The stronghold often continued to employ them in their old work of running inns, receiving visitors, and gathering information.

After the amnesty, Zhang Qing served Song Jiang against Liao, Tian Hu, Wang Qing, and Fang La, fighting across north and south. He died during the attack on Fang La's Shezhou. That day, as the armies clashed beneath the walls, Ou Peng, the Cloud-Brushing Golden Wings, was struck by an arrow and killed. His loss shook the Song army's morale and formation. Fang La's troops pressed their advantage, and Zhang Qing became trapped in the retreating mass, unable to advance or escape. He died in the confusion, with no clear account even of how he fell. Beginning in a monastery garden in Mengzhou, the Gardener had spent much of his life running the murderous Crossroads Slope inn, yet also sheltered heroes such as Lu Zhishen and Wu Song. He gained neither a peaceful religious death nor an official title, becoming only another lost soul in the rout beneath Shezhou's walls. Answering the name of the Earthly Punishment Star, he passed almost unnoticed amid the fighting, another Water Margin hero denied a good end.
菜园子张青，孟州人氏，乃梁山泊一百单八将中应地刑星的好汉，坐第一百零二把交椅。这.ja:
「菜園子」の張青は孟州の出身で、地刑星にあたり、梁山泊百八人の第百二位に列する。若いころは孟州の街道沿いにある光明寺で野菜を育て、菜園を世話して肥桶を担ぐ、地道な園丁だった。その仕事から菜園子の渾名を得たのである。だが気性は荒く、長く人の下に甘んじる男ではなかった。些細なことから寺の僧と争い、怒りに駆られて一山の僧を皆殺しにし、寺にも火を放った。以来、逃亡して孟州の大樹坡の下で追い剥ぎを始めた。妻は悪名高い女の豪傑、「母夜叉」の孫二娘である。のちに夫婦は孟州道の十字坡で酒店を開き、一人旅の商人を狙うようになった。酒肉に眠り薬を入れ、客が倒れると衣服と財物を奪う。肉付きのよい者は刻んで人肉饅頭の具にし、痩せた者や小柄な者は川溝へ捨てた。十字坡の店は江湖でも有名な悪辣な宿となり、夫婦の凶名は孟州の街道に広まった。

このような店を営みながらも、張青には独自の掟があった。普通の一人旅の商人には手を下すが、遊行の僧や道士、江湖を渡る芸人や妓女、罪を得て流刑に向かう囚人の三種は害さないと決めていたのである。この「三不害」の掟を通じて、のちに梁山で名を成す二人の好漢と知り合った。一人は花和尚の魯智深で、桃花村の騒動と瓦罐寺の焼き討ちを経て十字坡へ来た際、孫二娘に薬で倒されかけた。帰ってきた張青が気づいて急ぎ助け、二人は友となった。もう一人は行者の武松である。西門慶を殺して孟州へ流される途中、十字坡を通った武松に対し、孫二娘は配流者と知りながら薬を盛ろうとした。だが見抜かれ、逆に地面へ押さえつけられた。帰店した張青が止めに入り、詫びを尽くして武松と義兄弟になる。のちに鴛鴦楼で血を流し、行き場をなくした武松を頭陀姿に変装させ、二振りの戒刀と一式の衣装を与えたのもこの夫婦だった。武松の「行者」の名と生涯の装いは十字坡から生まれたのである。この庇護と援助にこそ、張青の義気が最もよく表れている。

張青は二竜山の好漢たちと共に梁山へ入った。武松と魯智深は後に青州の二竜山で山賊となり、張青夫婦とも連絡を保っていた。三山が義を結んで青州を攻め、そのまま梁山へ合流すると、張青と孫二娘も同行して頭領となった。大集結で席次が決まると、張青は地煞の地刑星として第百二位に列し、歩軍の将校を務めた。孫二娘も三人の女将の一人に数えられ、夫婦で梁山に入り、共に地煞へ列したことも一つの佳話となった。寨では以前の経験を生かし、店の運営や客の応対、情報収集を任されることが多かった。

招安後、張青は宋江の大軍に従って遼、田虎、王慶と戦い、江南の方臘討伐へも進んだ。各地で力を尽くした末、歙州攻めで命を落とした。その日、城下の混戦で、梁山の摩雲金翅、欧鵬が矢に当たって戦死する。宋軍は動揺して陣形を崩し、方臘軍が勢いに乗って追撃した。張青は敗走する乱軍に呑まれ、進むことも退くこともできず、どう死んだのかさえ明らかでないまま倒れた。孟州の光明寺の菜園から身を起こし、半生を十字坡の悪店で過ごしながら、魯智深や武松のような好漢を助けた菜園子は、安らかな入寂も官位の栄誉も得られなかった。ただ歙州城下の乱戦で一つの亡魂となったのである。地刑星の名に応じるかのように静かに陣中へ消えた、よい最期を迎えられなかった好漢の一人だった。

张顺，绰号「浪里白条」，应天损星，梁山泊英雄座次第三十位，乃水军头领之一。其人与.en:
Zhang Shun, the White Streak in the Waves, was the Heavenly Loss Star, ranked thirtieth among Liangshan's heroes and serving as a naval commander. From the same native place as his elder brother Zhang Heng, he lived by the Xunyang River, originally working as a fish broker and ferryman. His swimming surpassed every other Liangshan naval officer. With snow-white flesh, he could remain underwater for seven days and nights and move through the waves as easily as over level ground. His unmatched speed and sudden appearances amid the surf resembled a white fish darting through the water, earning his vivid nickname, also written as White Leaper in the Waves. Handsome and pale as snow, he was more alert and brotherly than Zhang Heng, and even better in the water: truly Water Margin's foremost aquatic hero.

Zhang Heng's introduction first connected him with Song Jiang. On his journey into exile at Jiangzhou, Song Jiang had nearly been killed by Zhang Heng's broad-blade noodles on the Xunyang River, but Li Jun saved him and helped bring him into contact with Zhang Shun. Later, while held in Jiangzhou, Song Jiang wanted fresh fish with his wine and went to the river with Dai Zong, the Marvelous Traveler, and Li Kui, the Black Whirlwind. Impatient Li Kui quarreled with the fish seller Zhang Shun, and they began fighting on the bank. Zhang Shun lured him into the river, then held the great dark man beneath the waves until he had swallowed water and suffered terribly. Their duel shows the full extent of Zhang Shun's aquatic mastery: however prodigious Li Kui's strength on land, in water he became a child entirely at Zhang Shun's mercy. Song Jiang and Dai Zong finally called a halt. Learning that Song Jiang stood before him, Zhang Shun bowed and formed a brotherly bond. When Song Jiang was later imprisoned for the rebellious poem at Xunyang Tower and taken for execution, Liangshan's heroes rescued him. Zhang Shun, Li Jun, Zhang Heng, the Ruan brothers, Tong Wei, Tong Meng, and the other river fighters provided support, gathered at White Dragon Temple, attacked Wuwei, and captured Huang Wenbing. After these Jiangzhou exploits, Zhang Shun joined the others at Liangshan.

There he commanded the navy and guarded its water strongholds alongside Li Jun, Zhang Heng, the Ruan brothers, Tong Wei, and Tong Meng. Whenever imperial forces attacked by water, he used his uncanny swimming to scuttle and overturn ships and capture enemy officers. His achievements in the two victories over Tong Guan and three defeats of Gao Qiu were especially notable. He sank official vessels from below and captured Gao Qiu alive; much of the navy's effectiveness rested on him. At the grand assembly, he received the Heavenly Loss Star's seat among the Heavenly Spirits. When a sore on Song Jiang's back later threatened his life, Zhang Shun volunteered to travel day and night across the river to Jiankang Prefecture and fetch the great physician An Daoquan. Overcoming dangers and eliminating the villains who blocked him, he brought the doctor back and saved Song Jiang, proving his loyalty, courage, and ingenuity.

After the amnesty, Zhang Shun won repeated extraordinary victories in naval battles against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing. His end in Fang La's campaign was both heroic and deeply tragic. At Hangzhou, Fang La's troops held strong defenses. Yongjin Gate on the city's west, facing West Lake, was a vital point. Confident in his unrivaled swimming, Zhang Shun planned to slip in at night through its water passage and open the gate for a coordinated assault. But the defenders were prepared. Swimming alone beneath Yongjin Gate, he was spotted from the walls. Crossbows fired together, and logs and rocks rained down. The White Streak in the Waves, a lifelong master of the water, was pierced by many arrows, staining West Lake with blood and dying beneath its surface, his body almost destroyed. When the news arrived, Song Jiang wept aloud and personally arranged memorial rites. Zhang Shun's heroic spirit later manifested at West Lake and gave aid through dreams. Moved by his loyalty, Song Jiang petitioned the court to establish a temple. Zhang Shun was granted the title General of Jinhua, honored after death with enduring offerings as protector of West Lake. His story became one of Water Margin's most moving accounts of a loyal soul.
张顺，绰号「浪里白条」，应天损星，梁山泊英雄座次第三十位，乃水军头领之一。其人与.ja:
張順は「浪裏白条」の渾名を持ち、天損星にあたる梁山泊第三十位の好漢で、水軍頭領の一人である。兄の張横と同郷で、潯陽江の一帯に暮らし、もとは川辺で魚の仲買と渡し船を営んでいた。泳ぎの腕は梁山の水将でも随一だった。雪のように白い肌を持ち、七日七晩も水底に潜み、波間を平地のように行き来できたという。風波の中に出没する速さは比類がなく、遠目には白い魚が波間で跳ねるように見えたため、浪裏白条、または浪裏白跳と呼ばれた。堂々たる容貌に雪をしのぐ白い肌を備え、兄よりも機敏で義に厚く、水中の技もさらに優れていた。まさしく『水滸伝』第一の水上の好漢である。

宋江と知り合うきっかけは兄の張横だった。江州へ流される途中の宋江は、潯陽江で張横の「板刀麺」によって殺されかけたが、李俊に救われ、その縁から張順とも結ばれた。のちに江州の牢にいた宋江が、酒の肴に鮮魚を欲しがり、神行太保の戴宗、黒旋風の李逵と川へ買いに行った。短気な李逵は魚売りの張順と争い、岸辺で殴り合いになった。張順は李逵を水へ誘い込み、黒い巨漢を波の中に押さえつけ、散々に水を飲ませて苦しめた。「黒旋風と浪裏白条の争い」は、張順の水中での神威を余さず示す。陸で千鈞の力を誇る李逵も、水に入れば幼子同然で、張順の思うままに扱われたのである。宋江と戴宗が止めると、張順は目の前の人物が宋公明だと知り、頭を下げて兄弟の交わりを結んだ。その後、宋江が潯陽楼の反詩で投獄され、刑場へ引かれると、梁山の好漢たちが救出に動いた。張順も李俊、張横、阮氏三兄弟、童威、童猛らと援護し、白竜廟に集まり、無為軍を攻めて黄文炳を捕らえた。江州での大騒動の後は、一同と共に梁山へ入った。

梁山では李俊、張横、阮氏三兄弟、童威、童猛らと水寨を守り、水軍を率いた。官軍が水路から攻めるたび、神出鬼没の泳ぎで敵船に穴を開け、転覆させ、敵将を生け捕った。童貫を二度、高俅を三度破る戦いでは、とりわけ大きな功を立てている。水底から官船を沈め、高俅を生け捕りにしたこともあり、水軍の強みの多くは彼に支えられていた。大集結では天罡の天損星に列した。また宋江が背の腫れ物で命を危ぶまれた際には、自ら志願して昼夜を急ぎ、川を渡って建康府へ名医の安道全を迎えに行った。途中の危難を越え、行く手を阻む悪人を倒し、ついに医師を山へ連れ帰って宋江を救った。この働きにも、忠勇と機転がよく表れている。

招安後、張順は遼、田虎、王慶との戦いに従い、水戦でたびたび奇功を挙げた。方臘討伐で迎えた最期は、壮烈であると同時に悲しい。杭州は方臘軍の大兵力が守り、西湖に面した城西の湧金門が要所となっていた。泳ぎに自信のある張順は、夜に潜入して水門から城門を開け、内外から呼応させようとした。だが敵は備えていた。単身泳いで湧金門の下へ着いたところを見つかり、城上から一斉に弩が放たれ、丸太と石が雨のように降った。水中に一生威を振るった浪裏白条は、乱矢に貫かれて西湖を血で染め、水底に没した。遺体さえほとんど保てぬ最期だった。知らせを受けた宋江は声を上げて泣き、自ら祭壇を設けて弔った。その後、張順の英魂は西湖に姿を現し、夢を通じて助力したという。忠義に感じた宋江が朝廷へ祠の建立を願い出ると、「金華将軍」の勅封が与えられた。死後も栄誉を受け、絶えぬ香火と共に西湖の土地を守る浪裏白条の物語は、『水滸伝』でも心を打つ忠魂の佳話となっている。

郑天寿，绰号「白面郎君」，浙西苏州人氏，应地异星，于梁山泊一百单八将中坐第七十四.en:
Zheng Tianshou, the Fair-Faced Gentleman, came from Suzhou in western Zhejiang. He was the Earthly Unusual Star, ranked seventy-fourth among Liangshan's 108 heroes and serving as an infantry chief. Red lips, white teeth, a face as pale as powder, and an elegant, handsome bearing earned him his refined nickname. Though he lived among outlaws, he looked like a young scholar of good family. His fair appearance did not mean a gentle hand: he wielded an iron spear with a steel point and was thoroughly skilled with it, yielding to no man in battle.

Originally a Suzhou silversmith, Zheng Tianshou had learned martial arts as a child and was generous by nature, eager to befriend heroes everywhere. Wandering later through the martial world, he came to Mount Qingfeng in Qingzhou, an outlaw stronghold held by Yan Shun, the Brocade-Furred Tiger, and Wang Ying, the Short-Legged Tiger. He fought Wang Ying below the mountain for fifty or sixty rounds without a decision. Watching with interest, Yan Shun admired the stranger's fine appearance and considerable skill, stepped in to make peace, and invited him to join them. Zheng Tianshou accepted their sincere welcome and swore brotherhood with both. Yan Shun sat to the left, Wang Ying in the middle, and Zheng Tianshou to the right as the three chiefs settled into their places, raiding households and dominating the area.

The Mount Qingfeng episode was an important stage in Song Jiang's flight and expanding friendships. After killing Yan Poxi, he passed the mountain while hiding from justice. Wang Ying's men captured him and nearly cut out his heart and liver for a sobering soup. Fortunately he gave his name. Hearing that this was Song Jiang, the Timely Rain, Yan Shun hastened to bow and beg forgiveness. Wang Ying and Zheng Tianshou did the same, treating him as an honored guest. Later, Wang Ying abducted the wife of Liu Gao, the official in charge of Qingfeng Fort, and Song Jiang persuaded him to release her. Hua Rong, the fort's military commander, was close to Song Jiang, but Liu Gao, its civil commander, framed them both and had them imprisoned. On hearing the news, Yan Shun, Wang Ying, and Zheng Tianshou brought their forces down, attacked the prison transport, rescued Song Jiang and Hua Rong, and defeated official troops in further trouble on the Qingzhou road. The affair had grown too large for them to remain, so Song Jiang wrote to Chao Gai recommending the group for Liangshan. Zheng Tianshou joined the main party and went there. The events at Mount Duiying on the road and the various adventures involving Wang Ying, Zheng Tianshou, and their companions before the Zhu Family Manor campaign also formed part of the Qingfeng group's path into Liangshan.

At Liangshan, Zheng Tianshou served with Yan Shun and Wang Ying in the infantry. At the grand assembly he took the seventy-fourth seat as the Earthly Unusual Star, commanding troops with his old companions and often charging with the main force. His practiced spear work and agility made him valuable in combat on foot. Like many Earthly Fiend commanders, however, he generally earned merit in combined operations, with few spectacular solo victories over enemy generals. After the imperial amnesty, he followed Song Jiang north against Liao and then against Tian Hu in Hebei and Wang Qing in Huaixi, surviving several years of campaigns across north and south.

Fang La's Jiangnan campaign brought devastating losses, and Zheng Tianshou was not spared. While fighting beneath Hangzhou's walls, he was struck in the melee by a millstone-sized rock hurled from above and killed instantly. A handsome hero thus died beneath an anonymous falling stone. When the court later honored those killed in suppressing Fang La, he received a posthumous title and a place on the roll of loyalty. The Fair-Faced Gentleman had made his way through the martial world with good looks, martial skill, and brotherly spirit, rising from Mount Qingfeng and following Song Jiang to the end. Though he never attained wealth or high distinction, his courage and loyalty secured his place among Liangshan's 108 and fulfilled the intention of his old oath on Qingfeng.
郑天寿，绰号「白面郎君」，浙西苏州人氏，应地异星，于梁山泊一百单八将中坐第七十四.ja:
鄭天寿は浙西の蘇州出身で、渾名は「白面郎君」。地異星にあたり、梁山泊百八人の第七十四位に列する歩軍頭領である。唇は紅く、歯は白く、顔は粉を塗ったように白かった。堂々として優雅な美貌を持ち、緑林に身を置きながら書生や若い貴公子のように見えたため、この渾名を得た。だが顔の白さとは裏腹に、手並みは甘くない。鋼の穂先を備えた鉄槍を使いこなし、戦場では誰にも引けを取らなかった。

もとは蘇州で銀を打って暮らす銀細工師だった。幼いころから武芸を身につけ、豪放な性格で天下の英雄と交わることを好んだ。やがて江湖を流浪し、青州の清風山の麓に至る。そこは錦毛虎の燕順と矮脚虎の王英が占める山賊の寨だった。鄭天寿は通りかかったところで王英と武芸を競い、五、六十合戦っても勝負がつかなかった。見ていた燕順は自分も腕を振るいたくなりながら、鄭天寿の風采と技量を惜しみ、間に入って和解させ、山の仲間になるよう誘った。誠実な扱いに感じた鄭天寿は快く承諾し、二人と義兄弟になった。燕順が左、王英が中央、鄭天寿が右に座して三頭領の位置を定め、人家を襲いながら一帯に勢力を張った。

清風山の挿話は、落難した宋江が広く豪傑と結ばれる重要な場面でもある。閻婆惜を殺して逃亡中の宋江が山を通ると、王英の手下に捕らえられ、心臓と肝をえぐって酔い覚ましの汁にされかけた。名を明かしたため命を救われ、及時雨の宋公明と知った燕順は急ぎ拝礼して詫び、王英と鄭天寿も頭を下げて上客として迎えた。のちに王英が清風寨の知寨、劉高の妻をさらうと、宋江は説得して放させた。さらに宋江と親しい武知寨の小李広、花栄が、文知寨の劉高に陥れられ、宋江と共に囚われる。知らせを受けた燕順、王英、鄭天寿は兵を率いて下山し、囚人車を襲って二人を救い、青州道でも官軍を打ち破った。騒動が大きくなり青州には留まれなくなったため、宋江は晁蓋へ推薦の手紙を書き、一党を梁山泊へ向かわせた。鄭天寿も大勢と共に入山し、梁山の一員となった。道中の対影山の一件や、祝家荘攻め以前に王英、鄭天寿らが関わった諸事件も、清風山勢が梁山へ合流する流れの一部である。

梁山では燕順、王英らと歩軍の戦いを担った。大集結で第七十四位、地異星に列し、旧来の仲間と一軍を率いて、しばしば大隊と共に突撃した。槍に熟達し身軽で、歩戦では頼もしい働きをしたが、多くの地煞の将と同じく、仲間と協力して功を立てることが多かった。単独で敵将を斬るような華々しい大功は少ない。招安後は宋江に従って遼へ北征し、勅命で河北の田虎、淮西の王慶を討ち、数年にわたる南北の転戦を無事に生き抜いた。

しかし江南の方臘討伐で梁山勢に甚大な死傷者が出ると、鄭天寿も免れなかった。杭州攻めで城下の敵軍と交戦中、城上から投げ落とされた臼石ほどの大石が乱軍の中の彼を直撃し、その場で命を奪った。端正な好漢が、名もない飛石の下に果てたのである。朝廷が方臘討伐の戦死者を追賞すると、鄭天寿にも追封が与えられ、忠義の名簿に記された。白面郎君は美貌と武芸と義気で江湖に立ち、清風山に起こって宋江と最後まで歩んだ。高い身分や栄華は得られなかったが、忠勇の名を梁山百八人の英雄譜に残し、清風山で義を結んだ初心を裏切らなかった。

周通者，绿林中一个剪径的强人也，落草于桃花山，做着打家劫舍的勾当。其人性情凶悍急.en:
Zhou Tong was a highway robber who occupied Mount Taohua and raided households. Fierce and impatient, he fought bravely with spear, long lance, and saber. People called him the Little Overlord. Overlord evoked Xiang Yu of Chu, suggesting exceptional strength and unchecked aggression; little acknowledged that Zhou Tong, despite his rough courage, remained a minor outlaw who relied on his strength to dominate the Taohua area. He shared the mountain with Li Zhong, the Tiger-Fighting General. Li Zhong was chief and Zhou Tong his deputy, gathering followers to rob passing travelers.

Zhou Tong's most famous episode is the attempted forced marriage at Peach Blossom Village. Traveling from Mount Wutai to the Great Xiangguo Monastery in the Eastern Capital, Lu Zhishen sought lodging at Elder Liu's manor in the village. Decorations and lanterns had been put up, but everyone looked as though disaster were imminent. On asking why, Lu learned that Zhou Tong had taken a fancy to Liu's only daughter and demanded her as his wife at the stronghold. Betrothal gifts had already arrived, and he was coming that night for the wedding. Unable to part with his only child yet afraid of the bandits, Elder Liu could only submit, leaving the entire household miserable. Lu Zhishen offered to persuade Zhou Tong to abandon the marriage. He had the daughter hidden away, stripped naked, and waited behind the bed curtains in the bridal chamber. Around the first watch, Zhou Tong arrived with his men amid music and fanfare. Delighted, he entered the dark room, felt his way toward the bed, and reached for his bride. Lu seized him, pinned him down, and struck him wildly with fists and feet. Squealing like a slaughtered pig, Zhou Tong rolled off the bed and fled. The Tattooed Monk's uproar at Peach Blossom Village is a richly comic scene, reducing the overbearing Little Overlord to a thoroughly battered fugitive.

Zhou Tong returned to the mountain and brought Li Zhong down for revenge. In the fighting, Li Zhong recognized the famous Lu Zhishen of Mount Wutai, and peace was made. Lu then urged Zhou Tong to reconsider: even with gifts sent, why seize a man's only daughter and tear a family apart? Reluctantly, out of regard for Lu Zhishen and Li Zhong, Zhou Tong abandoned the marriage and returned all the betrothal gifts to Elder Liu, ending the village's crisis. Lu stayed on Mount Taohua for a few days but found both chiefs narrow-minded and miserly hosts. When leaving, he carried off the stronghold's gold and silver drinking vessels. Li Zhong and Zhou Tong failed to catch him and had to let the matter go.

Later, in the events surrounding the three mountain bands' union and attack on Qingzhou, Huyan Zhuo led troops against the strongholds of Erlong, Taohua, and Baihu. Isolated on Taohua, Li Zhong and Zhou Tong sent to Liangshan for help. Song Jiang came with a large army, coordinated action from within and without, captured Qingzhou, and killed Prefect Murong. The heroes of all three mountains joined Liangshan, and Zhou Tong and Li Zhong abandoned their old stronghold to enter the marsh brotherhood.

At Liangshan's grand assembly, Zhou Tong became the Earthly Empty Star, ranked eighty-seventh among the Earthly Fiends. With Li Zhong he guarded the central army and stronghold. He could wield a spear or lance and fight on horseback, a willing and courageous subordinate commander. Yet he was no first-rank champion and generally served within the larger army on campaign.

After the amnesty, Zhou Tong accompanied Song Jiang against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing. The later terrible war against Fang La killed or wounded more than half the Liangshan chiefs. At Dusong Pass, Zhou Tong faced Fang La's formidable general Li Tianrun. He fought hard but was outmatched, and Li Tianrun cut him down beneath the pass. He died in Jiangnan and never returned. From outlawry on Taohua and the attempted marriage at Peach Blossom Village to Liangshan and death at Dusong Pass, the Little Overlord never quite lost his rough bandit's courage. Yet he ultimately followed the common cause and died in national service, completing his story as one of Water Margin's heroes.
周通者，绿林中一个剪径的强人也，落草于桃花山，做着打家劫舍的勾当。其人性情凶悍急.ja:
周通は桃花山に籠もり、人家や旅人を襲う緑林の強盗だった。気性は荒く短気で、槍を使い、長矛や大刀も手にして勇猛に戦ったため、「小霸王」と呼ばれた。「霸王」は楚の項羽の称号で、並外れた勇力と傍若無人な振る舞いを表す。そこに「小」が付くのは、周通が多少の蛮勇を備えていても、結局は腕力で桃花山一帯を支配する小さな山賊にすぎないことを示している。打虎将の李忠と共に山を占め、李忠が大頭領、周通が二頭領となって手下を集め、通行人から略奪していた。

周通の最も有名な挿話は、桃花村での強引な嫁取りである。五台山を離れて東京の大相国寺へ向かう魯智深が、桃花村の劉太公の屋敷に宿を借りた。灯籠や祝いの飾りがあるのに、人々は皆、災難を前にしたように沈んでいる。理由を尋ねると、桃花山の二頭領、周通が太公の一人娘を見初め、寨の妻にすると無理強いしていた。結納も済み、その夜に婚礼へ来る約束だという。太公は一人娘を手放せないが、山賊の力が怖く、なすがままになるしかなかった。魯智深は、自分が話をつけて娘との婚姻をやめさせようと申し出た。そして娘を隠させ、自らは裸になって花嫁の寝室の帳の中に座り、待ち受けた。初更ごろ、周通は音曲を鳴らし、手下を連れて婚礼に来た。喜び勇んで暗い部屋へ入り、寝台を探って花嫁に手を伸ばす。すると魯智深がその手をつかんで押さえ込み、拳と足でところかまわず殴りつけた。周通は屠られる豚のように叫び、寝台から転げ落ちて逃げ出した。花和尚が桃花村で起こすこの騒動は諧謔に富み、威張り散らす小霸王が無様に打ちのめされる、痛快な場面となっている。

ひどい目に遭った周通は山へ戻り、李忠を連れて報復に来た。だが戦い始めた李忠が相手を五台山の魯智深、江湖で名高い好漢と認めたため、両者は和解した。魯智深は周通に、結納をしたからといって、なぜ一人娘を奪い親子の仲を裂くのかと説いた。周通は不満ながら、魯智深と李忠の顔を立てて婚姻を取りやめ、結納の品もすべて劉太公へ返し、村は危難を免れた。魯智深は桃花山に数日滞在したが、二人の盗賊としての器量の狭さと客への吝嗇を嫌った。去る際に寨の金銀の酒器を持ち出して山を下り、李忠と周通は追いつけず、諦めるしかなかった。

のちに三山が義を結び青州を攻める一連の出来事では、呼延灼が兵を率いて二竜山、桃花山、白虎山を討伐した。孤立した桃花山の李忠と周通は梁山へ救援を求め、宋江が大軍を率いて到来した。内外から呼応して青州を破り、慕容知府を殺すと、三山の好漢は皆、梁山へ合流した。周通と李忠も桃花山を捨て、水泊の仲間となった。

梁山の大集結で天罡地煞の席次が定まると、周通は地煞の地空星として第八十七位に列した。李忠と共に中軍や山寨の守備を担った。槍や矛を使い、馬に乗って戦える勇敢な副将ではあったが、一流の猛将というほどではなく、大隊の一員として遠征に力を尽くすことが多かった。

招安後、周通は宋公明に従い、遼、田虎、王慶との戦いに加わった。方臘討伐の激戦では梁山頭領の半数以上が死傷した。周通は独松関へ進み、方臘配下の大将、厲天閏と交戦する。相手の武芸は高く、力を尽くしても及ばず、一刀に斬られて関の下に倒れた。江南で戦死し、帰還は果たせなかったのである。桃花山で山賊となり、桃花村で婚姻を強い、梁山へ帰順して独松関に果てた小霸王は、生涯、緑林の蛮勇を失わなかった。それでも最後は大義に従って国事に殉じ、水滸の群雄の一人として生涯を終えた。

朱富，绰号「笑面虎」，上应地藏星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十三位。其人本贯沂州沂水县，.en:
Zhu Fu, the Smiling Tiger, was the Earthly Hidden Treasure Star, ranked ninety-third among Liangshan's heroes. He came from Yishui County in Yizhou and was the younger brother of Zhu Gui, the Dry-Land Crocodile, who managed Liangshan's waterside outpost. Zhu Gui had joined the stronghold early and ran an inn below the mountain as an intelligence station. Zhu Fu remained in Yishui, running an inn of his own. Skilled at balancing flavors and preparing food and drink, he also understood medicines, including sleeping drugs and their antidotes. He was a clever, resourceful man who prepared carefully for whatever he undertook.

His nickname suited him perfectly. Round-faced as a full moon and always wearing a slight smile, he seemed amiable and entirely harmless, greeting everyone with warmth. Beneath that smile, however, lay a shrewd and calculating mind. There was a scheme behind his friendliness and a barb beneath his gentleness, just as the expression smiling tiger suggests: a cheerful face concealing predatory calculations. Most people saw only the smile, unaware that behind it stood a man outwardly accommodating but inwardly firm, calm in a crisis and decisive once he acted. At his inn he used his easy manner to deal with every sort of visitor while privately assessing people and affairs with great clarity. He was a master at hiding a sharp edge behind a friendly face.

His road to Liangshan began with Li Kui, the Black Whirlwind, going home for his mother. After joining the mountain, Li Kui missed her and returned to Yishui to bring her back to share his good fortune. Carrying her over Yiling Ridge, he seated her on a rock and went to fetch water. On returning he found that tigers had eaten her, leaving only her legs. Enraged, he killed four tigers with his bare hands to avenge her, an exploit that became famous. But it brought trouble. Elder Cao and local hunters recognized the notorious Liangshan outlaw. Cao pretended to entertain him while secretly sending to the authorities, hoping to claim a reward. The county constable Li Yun, the Blue-Eyed Tiger, was a skilled saber fighter and Zhu Fu's martial teacher. He was ordered to lead local soldiers and hunters to arrest Li Kui.

Hearing the news, Zhu Fu considered that Li Kui belonged to Liangshan, where his own brother already served; this might be his chance to join them. Yet if his formidable teacher delivered the prisoner for reward, everything would be spoiled. He devised a plan both to rescue Li Kui and to draw Li Yun into outlawry. Preparing food and wine laced with a sleeping drug, he intercepted the escort on the road and pretended to offer refreshments to his teacher and the soldiers. Unsuspecting, Li Yun and his men drank and collapsed. Zhu Fu freed Li Kui and met up with Zhu Gui. When Li Yun awoke, the prisoner was gone and he could no longer account for his duty. With no safe way forward or back, he yielded to repeated persuasion, abandoned his office, and joined Liangshan with Zhu Gui, Zhu Fu, and Li Kui. Thus Zhu Fu's drugging of his own teacher brought the Blue-Eyed Tiger into the brotherhood.

At the stronghold, Zhu Fu's cooking skills and knowledge of medicines led him to manage inns, prepare banquets, and oversee the troops' food and drink. He became a valuable member of the provisioning and kitchen staff. Liangshan's military celebrations and reward feasts depended on him and his fellow chiefs. At the grand assembly, he took the ninety-third seat as the Earthly Hidden Treasure Star, next to Zhu Gui. Both brothers were Earthly Fiends: one ran the inn and intelligence work below the mountain, while the other organized its kitchens and banquets, each complementing the other in his own duties.

After the amnesty, Zhu Fu accompanied the army against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing, continuing his work in food and supplies. The bitter war against Fang La cost Liangshan many heroes, but his death did not come from a blade. As the army fought around Hangzhou, an epidemic spread through its ranks. Zhu Fu fell ill, lingered on his sickbed, and finally died there in imperial service. More sorrowfully still, Zhu Gui contracted the same disease in the same place and period. The brothers died one after the other at Hangzhou, their shared lives ending in shared death. On returning, Song Jiang honored the officers lost to sickness, and Zhu Fu received posthumous recognition. The Smiling Tiger had no great battlefield victories, yet he brought Li Yun to Liangshan through a single scheme and spent years feeding the army. His smile concealed sound judgment and practical skill, making him an indispensable contributor to the stronghold.
朱富，绰号「笑面虎」，上应地藏星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十三位。其人本贯沂州沂水县，.ja:
朱富は「笑面虎」の渾名を持ち、地蔵星にあたる梁山泊第九十三位の好漢である。沂州沂水県の出身で、水亭を預かる「旱地忽律」の朱貴の実弟だった。兄は早くから梁山に入り、山の下で酒店を開いて情報を集めていたが、朱富は沂水県に残り、自分の店で酒を売っていた。五味を調え、料理や飲み物を作ることに長け、薬の性質や処方にも通じていた。眠り薬を盛り、解毒薬を調えることもできる、気が利いて手配の行き届いた人物だった。

笑面虎という渾名は、朱富の人柄をよく表している。満月のように丸い顔にはいつも薄い笑みがあり、穏やかで親しみやすく、凶相はまるでない。誰に対してもにこやかに応じた。だがその笑顔の下には、鋭く計算する心が隠れていた。笑いの中に策があり、柔らかさの中に刺がある。表では笑いながら、内には虎狼の思案を抱くという、まさに笑面虎である。人々は笑顔ばかりを見るが、実際には外は柔軟で内は堅く、事に臨んで乱れず、動けば結果を出す男だった。店に来るさまざまな客を愛想よく迎えながら、裏では人物や情勢を明確に見抜いていた。笑顔に刃を隠す、巧みな人物といえる。

梁山入りのきっかけは、黒旋風の李逵が母を迎えに帰った一件にある。入山した李逵は老母が恋しくなり、共に豊かな暮らしをさせようと沂水県へ戻った。母を背負って沂嶺を越え、岩に座らせて水を探しに行くと、戻った時には虎に食われ、両脚しか残っていなかった。怒った李逵は素手で四頭の虎を殺して仇を討ち、沂嶺の虎退治は評判となった。ところがこの出来事が災いを呼んだ。郷里の曹太公と猟師たちに梁山の大盗賊だと見抜かれ、太公は酒で歓待するふりをしながら官府へ通報し、捕らえて褒賞を得ようとしたのである。県の都頭には、刀をよく使う「青眼虎」の李雲がいた。朱富の武芸の師でもある彼が、郷兵と猟師を率いて李逵を捕らえるよう命じられた。

知らせを聞いた朱富は、李逵が梁山の好漢であり、兄も山にいることから、これを入山の機会にできると考えた。ただし武芸の高い師が本当に李逵を役所へ渡せば、大事は台無しになる。そこで李逵を救うと同時に、李雲も山賊の仲間へ引き込む策を立てた。自ら酒肉を用意して密かに眠り薬を入れ、道の途中で師と兵たちを慰労するふりをしたのである。疑わぬ李雲と一同が口にすると、次々と倒れた。朱富は李逵を救い、兄の朱貴とも合流した。薬が切れて目覚めた李雲は、囚人を失って任務の申し開きができず、進退に窮した。幾度も説かれた末、やむなく官職を捨て、朱貴、朱富、李逵と共に梁山へ入った。これが、朱富が師に薬を盛り、青眼虎を大義の仲間へ加えた顛末である。

入山後は料理と薬の知識を買われ、酒店や宴席を取り仕切り、将兵の飲食を調える役を担った。補給と厨房を支える頼もしい働き手となったのである。三軍の慰労や集会のたび、朱富ら頭領がその準備をした。大集結で百八人の席次が定まると、地蔵星として第九十三位となり、朱貴と隣り合った。兄弟は共に地煞に列し、一方は山下の店と諜報を、もう一方は山中の酒宴と厨房を受け持った。それぞれの役目がよく補い合っていた。

招安後、朱富は遼、田虎、王慶との戦いに従軍し、飲食と補給の仕事で力を尽くした。方臘討伐では梁山勢に多くの犠牲者が出たが、彼を襲ったのは刀槍ではなかった。杭州周辺を転戦する軍中に疫病が広まり、多くの将兵が倒れたのである。朱富も感染して長く床につき、ついに杭州の軍中で病死し、王事に殉じた。さらに悲しいことに、兄の朱貴も同じ土地、同じ時期に疫病を得て没した。兄弟は杭州で相次いで命を落とし、共に生き、共に死ぬ結末となった。宋江の帰還後、病没した将佐が追悼され、朱富にも追贈が与えられた。笑面虎には戦場の大功こそないが、一計で李雲を入山させ、長年にわたり三軍の食を支えた。笑顔の下にある明晰さと実務の才によって、梁山に欠かせぬ功臣となったのである。

朱贵，绰号「旱地忽律」，上应地囚星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十二位，乃梁山泊最早一班的.en:
Zhu Gui, the Dry-Land Crocodile, was the Earthly Prisoner Star, ranked ninety-second among Liangshan's heroes. One of the stronghold's earliest founding chiefs, he managed the inns below the mountain, gathered news from travelers, and received would-be recruits. He came from Yishui County in Yizhou and had a younger brother, Zhu Fu, the Smiling Tiger, who later joined Liangshan too. In seniority, Zhu Gui belonged to its oldest veterans. When Wang Lun, the White-Robed Scholar, first occupied the marsh, the small stronghold consisted of Wang Lun as chief, Du Qian and Song Wan as deputies, and Zhu Gui running the inn and intelligence post below. That was the whole of early Liangshan.

His nickname carried a precise meaning. Huli was a vicious kind of crocodile, lurking underwater until a person or animal approached, then lunging and dragging its victim beneath the surface. Zhu Gui operated on dry land instead. His inn made him appear honest and friendly, but secretly it was one of Liangshan's claws beyond the mountain. He watched passing merchants closely; those worth robbing were drugged, stripped of their wealth, or sent up to the stronghold. Important heroes seeking refuge were verified by secret signals and warmly received. The peaceful exterior, concealed danger, and patient waiting for prey resembled a crocodile on land, hence the name. Thin and yellow-faced, he was not striking in appearance, but his careful mind and practiced handling of affairs made him exceptionally thorough.

His inn stood at the Li Family Crossing on the shore of Liangshan Marsh, serving as the stronghold's eyes, ears, and gateway. It had secret arrangements: boats waited by the water and whistling arrows were kept inside. Heroes wishing to join first rested at the inn and had their identities checked. Zhu Gui then shot an arrow into the reeds across the water, summoning a boat from the water stronghold to ferry them over. Shooting from the waterside pavilion to call a boat was his particular specialty. When Lin Chong, the Panther Head, came to Liangshan on a snowy night, Zhu Gui's inn was his first stop, and an arrow summoned the ferry that brought him into the band. Chao Gai, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King, and his companions also took shelter there after their theft of the birthday gifts was discovered. Before Liangshan flourished, many a hero's journey into it began across the threshold of this little inn.

When Lin Chong killed the narrow-minded Wang Lun and the others acclaimed Chao Gai, Zhu Gui remained a dutiful veteran. He neither defended Wang Lun to the death nor competed for command, simply accepting service under the new leader. As Chao Gai and then Song Jiang took charge and Liangshan grew to 108 heroes, Zhu Gui's work of gathering news and receiving newcomers never changed. Warriors who charged the enemy were essential, but the gateway that passed intelligence and welcomed friends could not be neglected for a moment. At the grand ranking, he took the ninety-second seat as the Earthly Prisoner Star, continuing to oversee inn-based intelligence on the eastern and western approaches. He and Zhu Fu stood among the Earthly Fiends, with Zhu Gui responsible for visitors and military information.

Zhu Gui was no fierce battlefield champion; his achievements lay around the army's command arrangements and entrances. Before expeditions or official attacks, he investigated enemy strengths and weaknesses and relayed news, ensuring the stronghold remained informed and could respond calmly. In the two victories over Tong Guan and three defeats of Gao Qiu, he worked behind the scenes on coordination and support, earning many quiet merits.

After the amnesty, Zhu Gui served against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing, continuing his intelligence and liaison duties. The brutal Fang La campaign cost Liangshan many heroes, but his fate came neither from spear nor arrow. While the army fought around Hangzhou, an epidemic left many soldiers and officers ill. Aged and worn down, Zhu Gui contracted it, lingered on his sickbed, and died in the army in imperial service. This veteran founder had welcomed guests below the mountain since Wang Lun's time, lived through the leaderships of Wang Lun, Chao Gai, and Song Jiang, and guided countless heroes into Liangshan. Yet he could not return with the army and died far from home. Zhu Fu caught the same disease in the same place and period; the brothers died in succession at Hangzhou, sharing death as they had shared life. After returning, Song Jiang commemorated those lost to sickness, and Zhu Gui received posthumous honors. The Dry-Land Crocodile had no earth-shaking military triumphs, but from Liangshan's founding to the southern expedition he quietly maintained its eyes, ears, and doorway. He stayed with the stronghold from beginning to end, a steadfast and indispensable contributor.
朱贵，绰号「旱地忽律」，上应地囚星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十二位，乃梁山泊最早一班的.ja:
朱貴は「旱地忽律」の渾名を持ち、地囚星にあたる梁山泊第九十二位の好漢である。山寨創設時からの頭領の一人で、山下の酒店を預かり、往来の情報を探り、身を寄せる者を迎えた。沂州沂水県の出身で、弟の「笑面虎」朱富も後に梁山へ加わる。朱貴は経歴からいえば最古参に数えられる。白衣秀士の王倫が水泊を占めた草創期には頭領も少なく、王倫を主に杜遷、宋万が補佐し、朱貴が山下で店と情報収集を受け持つというのが、梁山の全容だった。

旱地忽律という渾名には意味がある。忽律とは凶暴な鰐の類で、水底に潜み、人や家畜が近づくと突然襲って水中へ引きずり込む。朱貴は水中にいる代わりに、陸の酒店を構えていた。見た目は実直で穏やかだが、実際は山の外へ伸びる梁山の鋭い爪だったのである。通りかかる商人の言動を観察し、金目の物があれば眠り薬で倒して財物を奪うか、山へ送った。一方、有力な好漢が帰順を求めて来れば、合図で身元を確かめて丁重に迎えた。穏やかな外見に殺意を隠し、地に伏して獲物を待つ手口が、陸の鰐に似ているため、この名を得た。黄色く痩せた顔で風采は目立たないが、思慮深く仕事に慣れ、何事にも細心で行き届いた人物だった。

店は梁山泊の岸辺、李家道口にあり、山寨の耳目と玄関口を兼ねていた。密かな仕組みも備え、水際には船、店内には鳴り矢を用意していた。入山を望む好漢が来ると、まず店で休ませて身元を調べる。朱貴が対岸の葦の奥へ鳴り矢を放てば、水寨から迎えの船が来た。水亭から矢を射て渡し船を呼ぶのが、彼の得意の役目だった。豹子頭の林冲が雪の夜に梁山へ来た時も、初めにこの店へ入り、朱貴の矢で呼ばれた船に乗って仲間となった。生辰綱を奪ったことが露見して逃れてきた托塔天王の晁蓋らも、まずここに身を落ち着けた。梁山が栄える前、多くの好漢の第一歩は、この小さな酒店の敷居をまたぐことだったのである。

狭量な王倫を林冲が殺し、人々が晁蓋を推した時、古参の朱貴は分を守った。王倫を命懸けで庇うことも、主の座を争うこともなく、皆と共に新しい頭領に従った。その後、晁蓋、宋江と主が替わり、梁山が発展して百八人を集めても、情報収集と来客の案内という仕事は変わらなかった。敵陣へ突進する将も必要だが、消息を伝え、仲間を迎える玄関と耳目の働きは一刻も欠かせない。大集結では地囚星として第九十二位に列し、引き続き山の東西の道にある酒店の諜報を預かった。朱富と共に地煞に属し、人の出入りと軍情の探索を専門に担った。

朱貴は戦場で敵と斬り結ぶ猛将ではない。その功は軍の運営や出入口にあった。遠征や官軍の侵攻に先立って敵の実情を探り、知らせを届け、山寨が広く状況を知って落ち着いて対処できるようにした。童貫を二度、高俅を三度破る戦いでも、裏方として段取りや連絡、援護に尽力し、目立たぬ功を数多く積み重ねた。

招安後、朱貴は遼、田虎、王慶との戦いにも従い、情報収集と連絡の仕事で軍に尽くした。方臘討伐の激戦では梁山の好漢が多数失われたが、彼を襲ったのは刀槍や矢ではなかった。杭州一帯を転戦する軍に疫病が広まり、多くの将兵が倒れたのである。年齢と疲労が重なった朱貴も感染し、長く病床に伏した末、杭州の軍中で王事に殉じた。王倫の時代から山下で客を迎え、王倫、晁蓋、宋江の三代を見届け、数知れぬ英雄を山へ送った古参の好漢が、自らは帰還できず異郷に没したのである。弟の朱富も同じ土地、同じ時期に疫病で死に、兄弟は杭州で相次いで命を落とした。共に生き、共に死ぬ幕引きだった。帰還した宋江が病没者を追悼すると、朱貴にも追贈が与えられた。旱地忽律には天地を驚かす戦功こそないが、草創期から南征まで、黙々と梁山の門戸と耳目を守った。山寨と始終を共にした、実直で欠かせぬ功臣だったのである。

朱仝，山东郓城县人氏，原是郓城县的马兵都头，与步兵都头雷横并称，同为县衙缉捕的得.en:
Zhu Tong came from Yuncheng County in Shandong. Originally its chief mounted constable, he was paired with Lei Heng, chief of the foot constables, as an effective officer of the county court. Eight chi four or five cun tall, with a thick beard a chi and a half long, a dark-red face, and bright eyes, he had a striking, dignified appearance resembling Guan Yu reborn. People therefore called him Zhu Tong, the Beautiful Beard. He rode a swift horse, wielded a long-handled broadsword, and could hold his own in battle. More especially, he was generous, broad-hearted, and eager to befriend heroes through kindness. Within the machinery of criminal justice, he preserved a warm desire to save people.

As a Yuncheng constable, he twice saved future Liangshan men. When the seven men's clever theft of the birthday gifts was exposed, Jizhou sent orders for arrests. Zhu Tong and Lei Heng surrounded Chao Gai's manor at East Creek Village. Knowing Chao Gai to be a worthy man and wishing to let him live, Zhu Tong deliberately placed most troops at the front while quietly taking a detachment to the rear. When Chao Gai and his companions escaped that way, he pretended he could not catch them, allowing their flight to Stone Tablet Village and Liangshan. Later, after Song Jiang killed Yan Poxi and faced urgent pursuit, Zhu Tong again worked secretly within the county court and passed warnings that let him escape. These two releases demonstrated a generosity and chivalry far removed from the usual harshness of petty officials.

Lei Heng later killed Bai Xiuying, a prostitute favored by the magistrate, and was displayed in a cangue for murder. While escorting him, Zhu Tong remembered their brotherly ties and Lei Heng's elderly mother. He unlocked the restraints, released his colleague, and accepted the blame himself. Furious, the magistrate had him tattooed and exiled to Cangzhou. There the prefect valued his imposing appearance and honest nature, often letting him carry the prefect's charming four-year-old son through the streets. To force Zhu Tong into Liangshan, however, Wu Yong devised a plan, Lei Heng guided it, and Li Kui performed the killing. On the night of the Ghost Festival, while Zhu Tong took the child to see the lanterns, Li Kui lured the boy aside and split him in two with an axe. Finding the child dead with his brains spilled, Zhu Tong was shocked and grief-stricken. He knew Liangshan was responsible and that his future in Cangzhou was ruined. He hated Li Kui and repeatedly tried to fight him to the death. Only extensive apologies and persuasion from Song Jiang, Wu Yong, and Chai Jin restrained him. Unable to return home or remain an official, he had no choice but to join Liangshan. The scheme to recruit Zhu Tong is one of the novel's most distressing episodes: an innocent child is murdered to turn an upright man into an outlaw. It reveals the suffering not only of those driven to Liangshan but also of those tricked into joining it.

At the grand assembly, Zhu Tong ranked twelfth among the Heavenly Spirits as the Heavenly Fullness Star. He became one of the Eight Cavalry Vanguard Commanders alongside Hua Rong, Xu Ning, Yang Zhi, and others, a seasoned senior general of the stronghold. In sieges and field battles he charged on horseback with his long-handled broadsword and won distinction. His steady judgment also earned deep respect from his companions.

Following the amnesty, Zhu Tong served Song Jiang against Liao, Tian Hu, Wang Qing, and Fang La, enduring long campaigns across north and south and defeating many foes. He survived intact, one of the fortunate exceptions among Liangshan's fallen heroes. After Fang La's defeat, the court appointed him military commander of Baoding Prefecture, restoring his official service. When Jin armies later invaded the south, the veteran donned armor again and fought under the famous general Liu Guangshi against the foreign enemy. Repeated achievements raised him to military governor of Taiping, and he lived out his years in wealth and high office. From Yuncheng mounted constable to Liangshan cavalry vanguard and then imperial defender and governor, the Beautiful Beard remained chivalrous, generous, loyal, and steady. Twice saving heroes beyond the demands of the law, he ultimately gained honor and renown. His successful career, long life, and fortunate ending were rare among the men of Water Margin.
朱仝，山东郓城县人氏，原是郓城县的马兵都头，与步兵都头雷横并称，同为县衙缉捕的得.ja:
朱仝は山東の鄆城県出身で、もとは県の馬兵都頭を務め、歩兵都頭の雷横と並んで役所の捕り物を支えた有能な吏員だった。身の丈八尺四、五寸、一尺五寸の立派な虎髯をたくわえ、顔は熟した棗のように赤く、目は星のように輝いていた。堂々たる非凡な風貌は関雲長の再来を思わせ、人々は「美髯公朱仝」と呼んだ。朴刀を使い、駿馬を操り、戦場で渡り合う腕もある。人柄はとりわけ義に厚く財を惜しまず、寛大で、恩義をもって豪傑と交わった。刑罰を扱う役所の中にいても、人を救おうとする温かな心を失わなかった。

鄆城の都頭時代、朱仝は梁山へつながる好漢を二度救っている。初めは晁蓋ら七人による生辰綱の奪取が露見し、済州府から捕縛の命が来た時だった。朱仝と雷横は東渓村の晁家荘を囲んだが、晁蓋を好漢と知る朱仝には逃がす心があった。そこで兵の多くを表門に置き、自分は一隊を率いて密かに裏門を守った。晁蓋らが裏から抜けると追いつけぬふりをし、石碣村を経て梁山へ逃れる道を開いた。次に宋江が閻婆惜を殺して厳しく追われた際も、役所内で密かに取り計らい、知らせを送って遠くへ逃がした。この二度の義ある釈放には、並の役人の冷酷さとは異なる、寛大な侠気が表れている。

その後、雷横は知県と親しい妓女の白秀英を殴り殺し、首枷を着けられて晒された。護送を任された朱仝は、同僚との兄弟の情と、彼に老母がいることを思い、枷を開いて逃がし、自分一人で責任を負った。怒った知県により刺青を施され、滄州へ流される。滄州知府は堂々たる容貌と実直さを気に入り、可愛らしい四歳の息子を抱いて町へ遊びに連れ出させていた。ところが梁山は朱仝を入山させるため、呉用が策を立て、雷横が道を案内し、李逵に凶行を行わせた。盂蘭盆の夜、朱仝が子を抱いて灯籠を見に出た隙に、李逵が人気のない場所へ誘い、斧で真っ二つにして殺したのである。子が脳を散らして死んでいるのを見た朱仝は、驚きと悲痛に襲われた。梁山の仕業だと知り、滄州で暮らす道を断たれて進退に窮した。李逵を憎み、何度も命懸けで争おうとしたが、宋江、呉用、柴進がひたすら詫び、説得してようやく収めた。家にも帰れず官にも戻れない朱仝は、やむなく梁山へ入った。無辜の幼児を殺し、忠厚な好漢を山賊にするこの計略は、読むに忍びない惨酷な一段である。世に追い詰められて梁山へ行く者だけでなく、計略で引き込まれる者の苦しみも示している。

大集結では天罡の第十二位、天満星に列し、馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使の一人となった。花栄、徐寧、楊志らと並ぶ、歴戦の上将である。攻城戦でも野戦でも朴刀を手に馬を駆って突撃し、戦功を挙げた。さらに重厚で慎みのある人柄から、仲間の深い敬意を集めていた。

招安後、朱仝は宋江に従って遼、田虎、王慶を破り、南下して方臘を討った。南北を転戦する馬上の苦労を重ね、朴刀で多くの敵を倒しながら、自身は無事に生き残った。多くの英雄が失われた梁山では、よい結末を迎えた貴重な一人である。方臘平定後は保定府都統制を授かり、再び朝廷の軍人となった。のちに金軍が大挙して南侵すると、老練の将として甲冑を着け、名将劉光世のもとで外敵と戦った。たびたび功を立て、太平軍節度使にまで昇り、高位と富を得て老後を全うした。鄆城の馬兵都頭から水泊の先鋒、そして国を守る節度使へ進んだ美髯公は、一生を通じて義侠と忠厚、重厚さを保った。法の枠を越えて二度も豪傑を救った男が、最後には栄誉と名声を得たのである。功成り名を遂げ、福寿にも恵まれた、物語の中でも数少ない好漢だった。

神机军师朱武，定远人氏，乃梁山泊三十六员天罡之后、七十二地煞之首，应地魁星，坐第.en:
Zhu Wu, the Resourceful Strategist, came from Dingyuan. Ranked thirty-seventh at Liangshan, immediately after the thirty-six Heavenly Spirits, he headed the seventy-two Earthly Fiends as the Earthly Leader Star. He handled military secrets and advised on operations. Though lacking the strength to face ten thousand men, he carried a million armored soldiers in his mind. He understood formations, hidden principles, the Six Secret Teachings and Three Strategies, yin and yang, and the Five Elements. His ability to read the enemy and foresee events earned him his nickname. Like Wu Yong, he was a planner who could determine distant victories from the command tent; he had simply arrived later and held a lower position.

In his early years, Zhu Wu joined Chen Da, the Ravine-Leaping Tiger, and Yang Chun, the White-Spotted Snake, in outlawry on Mount Shaohua in Huayin County, Huazhou. They raided households and stored grain and fodder, with Zhu Wu as chief. The mountain stood near Shi Family Village, home of Shi Jin, the Nine-Dragoned. One day, despite Zhu Wu and Yang Chun's warnings, Chen Da insisted on passing through the village to raid Huayin for grain. He fought Shi Jin and was captured alive. Rather than send troops, Zhu Wu and Yang Chun appealed through self-sacrifice. Binding their own hands, they went to Shi Manor and knelt to ask for death, declaring that their sworn brotherhood meant they must live or die with Chen Da. Moved by their loyalty, Shi Jin did not turn them in for a reward but released Chen Da and began secretly exchanging visits and gifts with all three. When word of these ties later escaped, Shi Jin burned his manor, left home, and joined Shaohua. Zhu Wu and the others made him chief. This scheme to win Shi Jin through self-sacrifice was the first famous demonstration of Zhu Wu's ingenuity and his use of wisdom to preserve brotherhood.

The Shaohua band faced further troubles. Seeking to rescue the painter Wang Yi from official custody and kill the corrupt Prefect He, Shi Jin entered Huazhou alone and was imprisoned. Lu Zhishen, Song Jiang, and Liangshan's army eventually captured the city and rescued him, after which Shaohua merged into Liangshan. Zhu Wu became a dedicated military adviser alongside Wu Yong and Gongsun Sheng, contributing to troop deployments, formations, camps, and calculations of auspicious timing. At the grand assembly he headed the Earthly Fiends, thirty-seventh overall, showing how highly Song Jiang and Wu Yong valued his strategic gifts.

Zhu Wu seldom fought in person; his strength lay entirely in intelligence. After the amnesty, he accompanied Song Jiang against Liao. Whenever the enemy deployed strange formations, he climbed to a vantage point, analyzed their approaches and openings, and showed the generals where to attack and break through, earning considerable quiet merit. In Fang La's campaign, Jiangnan's dangerous terrain and powerful enemy again called for his advice on advance and retreat. Yet seven in ten of the 108 Heavenly Spirits and Earthly Fiends were lost in the south, leaving the old brotherhood devastated. Chen Da and Yang Chun, his companions in life and death from the earliest Shaohua days, both perished amid the blades of Fang La's war. Watching his old friends fall tore Zhu Wu's heart apart.

After Fang La's defeat, as the army returned to receive rewards, Zhu Wu was disillusioned. Fame and wealth seemed empty in the end. Unwilling to remain bound to the court, he joined Fan Rui, the Demon King of Chaos, another man versed in magic and inclined toward withdrawal from worldly affairs. They abandoned their commissions, went to Mount Erxian to seek Gongsun Sheng, and entered religious life under Master Luo. Studying the Way of Complete Perfection, contemplating its mysteries, and practicing in peace, Zhu Wu spent his remaining years among woods and streams. Compared with the many brothers who died on the battlefield or met unhappy ends, he was among the few who understood when to stop. His ingenuity began among the outlaws and ended in the freedom of a Taoist recluse, an ending worthy of the Resourceful Strategist.
神机军师朱武，定远人氏，乃梁山泊三十六员天罡之后、七十二地煞之首，应地魁星，坐第.ja:
神機軍師の朱武は定遠の出身で、梁山泊の三十六天罡に続く七十二地煞の首位、地魁星として第三十七位に列し、軍の機密と作戦の助言を担った。万夫不当の勇力はなくとも、胸には百万の甲兵を蔵していた。陣を敷き、機微を知り、六韜三略や陰陽五行に通じ、敵を見て事態を見通す力は神業のようだったため、神機軍師と呼ばれたのである。呉用と同じく、帷幄の中で策を巡らし千里の勝敗を決める人物で、入山がやや遅かったため、その下に位置していた。

若いころの朱武は、跳澗虎の陳達、白花蛇の楊春と共に、華州華陰県の少華山で山賊をしていた。人家を襲い、糧秣を蓄え、朱武が寨主を務めた。山は九紋竜の史進が暮らす史家村に近かった。ある日、陳達は朱武と楊春の制止を聞かず、華陰県へ食糧を取りに行くため史家村を通ろうとし、史進に敗れて生け捕られた。知らせを受けた朱武と楊春は兵を出さず、自ら苦境を示して情に訴える策を使った。両手を縛って史進の屋敷へ行き、義兄弟三人は生死を共にするのだから、陳達と一緒に死なせてほしいと跪いたのである。厚い義気に感じた史進は、役所へ渡して褒賞を求めるどころか陳達を放し、三人と密かに往来して贈り物を交わすようになった。やがて交際が露見すると、史進は屋敷を焼いて家を捨て、少華山へ入った。朱武らは彼を頭領に推した。この苦肉の策で史進を引き入れた一件は、知恵で義を守る朱武の機転を示す、最初の名場面である。

その後も少華山の一党は曲折を重ねた。史進は官府に捕らえられた絵師の王義を救い、貪官の賀太守を殺そうと単身華州へ入ったが、かえって牢に囚われた。魯智深や梁山の宋江らの大軍が華州を破って救い出したことで、少華山は梁山へ合流した。朱武は軍の参謀を専門に務め、呉用、公孫勝らと軍師に並び、兵の配置や陣形、宿営、天の時の推算に知恵を貸した。大集結で地煞の首位、総席次第三十七位となったことからも、宋江と呉用がその兵略を高く評価していたと分かる。

朱武が自ら激戦を演じる場面は少なく、長所はすべて知にあった。招安後に宋江と遼へ北征すると、敵が奇妙な陣を敷くたび高所から観察し、その仕組みや出入口を読み解いて、どこから突き、どこを破るかを諸将に教えた。目立たぬところで大きな功を立てたのである。方臘討伐でも、険しい江南の山河と強大な敵を相手に、軍の進退をたびたび助言した。しかし百八人の天罡地煞は江南で十のうち七を失い、旧友たちは死傷していった。少華山から生死を共にしてきた陳達と楊春も、共に方臘戦の乱軍の刃に倒れた。故人が一人ずつ失われるのを目にした朱武の心は、切り裂かれるようだった。

方臘が平定され、凱旋して恩賞を受けるころ、朱武はすでに意気を失い、功名富貴も最後には空しいものだと悟っていた。朝廷に縛られ続けることを望まず、同じく法術に通じ、世俗を離れる心を持つ混世魔王の樊瑞と連れ立ち、官の辞令を捨てた。二人は二仙山の公孫勝を頼って出家し、羅真人の門下で全真の道法を学んだ。玄理を究め、静かに修行し、林泉の間で余生を全うしたのである。戦場に果て、よい最期を得られなかった多くの兄弟に比べ、朱武は物事を見抜き、退く時を知った数少ない一人だった。緑林に始まった一身の知略は、最後に道士の自由な隠遁へ帰した。それもまた神機軍師の名にふさわしい結末といえよう。

邹润，绰号「独角龙」，上应地角星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十一位，乃登州登云山一伙好汉.en:
Zou Run, the One-Horned Dragon, was the Earthly Horn Star, ranked ninety-first among Liangshan's heroes and belonging to the Mount Dengyun band from Dengzhou. A Dengzhou native of unremarkable family background, he lived as an outlaw with his uncle Zou Yuan, gathering fugitives and raiding households. The pair were local comrades bound by sworn fellowship, though they addressed one another as uncle and nephew. Zou Yuan was the Forest-Emerging Dragon and Zou Run the One-Horned Dragon. One dragon before the other, they were known all along the Dengzhou roads.

Zou Run's nickname arose from a peculiar feature. A raised lump of flesh and unusual bone grew from his skull, hard as rock and jutting like a single horn. It was more than a curious appearance: his iron-hard head gave him a natural weapon. A headbutt from him carried enormous force, and he once broke a green pine thick enough to encircle with both arms in a single blow. In ordinary fights, anyone he struck with his head fell at once, spreading fear of the One-Horned Dragon. Upright, direct, and quick to act, he valued friendship and sworn loyalty. He and Zou Yuan held Mount Dengyun and enjoyed a formidable reputation.

His path to Liangshan began with the Dengzhou prison break. Two hunters outside the city, the brothers Xie Zhen and Xie Bao, were ordered by the prefect to hunt a tiger. They succeeded, but the wealthy local Elder Mao stole the credit and then accused them of robbery, having them put on death row with the intention of killing them. Their cousin Gu Dasao, the Tigress, ran an inn in Dengzhou. Fierce, chivalrous, and devoted to family, she heard of the injustice and planned a rescue with her husband Sun Xin, the Little Yuchi. They also called on his elder brother Sun Li, the Sickly Yuchi, Dengzhou's military inspector. But a few people alone could hardly break a prison and defy the authorities. Sun Xin went to Dengyun and enlisted Zou Yuan and Zou Run, along with Yue He, the Iron Whistle, and other heroes. Working together from inside and outside, they broke into the prison, freed the Xie brothers, and killed Elder Mao's entire household to avenge the wrong. Exposed and left with nowhere to stay, the eight Dengzhou companions gathered their men and set off for Liangshan. Zou Run thus left Mount Dengyun to join them.

They arrived while Song Jiang's repeated attacks on Zhu Family Manor remained blocked. Sun Li proposed using his former fellow student Luan Tingyu, the manor's instructor. He would claim to have been transferred from Dengzhou to guard Yunzhou, gain entrance, and help from within. Delighted, Song Jiang accepted. Zou Run joined the others in official uniforms and infiltrated the manor, waiting to provide support. When Liangshan attacked together, Sun Li's group turned against the defenders from inside. The coordinated assault threw the manor into chaos and finally broke its stubborn resistance. Zou Run fought hard and won distinction, using these first services to secure his formal place at Liangshan.

After joining, Zou Run was no senior general capable of commanding an entire front, but his agility and powerful headbutts made him a fierce subordinate officer. He participated in the two victories over Tong Guan, the three defeats of Gao Qiu, and other great battles, never hanging back. At the grand assembly, he took the ninety-first seat as the Earthly Horn Star, immediately beside Zou Yuan. The two dragons, uncle and nephew together among the Earthly Fiends, became a celebrated pair. He remained available for military assignments and coordinated attacks and defenses.

Following the amnesty, Zou Run accompanied the army against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing, serving in every campaign across north and south with his uncle always beside him. Fang La's bitter Jiangnan war cost Liangshan many men, but both survived and returned, fortunate exceptions among the Earthly Fiends. When the army reached court, Zou Run could have accepted an official reward and appointment. Accustomed to freedom, however, he had no desire for office or the constraints of paperwork and administration. He declined fame and returned with Zou Yuan to Mount Dengyun in Dengzhou to live happily in the hills. From outlawry to the prison rescue, distinction at Zhu Family Manor, campaigns in every direction, and retirement after success, Zou Run always advanced and withdrew with his uncle, never abandoning him. Their familial loyalty ran through the whole story. Compared with the brothers buried after battle in Jiangnan, his safe withdrawal to his old mountain was a fortunate and complete ending.
邹润，绰号「独角龙」，上应地角星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十一位，乃登州登云山一伙好汉.ja:
鄒潤は「独角竜」の渾名を持ち、地角星にあたる梁山泊第九十一位の好漢で、登州登雲山の一党に属していた。登州の出身で家柄は高くなく、普段は叔父の鄒淵と登雲山に籠もり、無頼の者を集め、人家を襲って緑林の稼業を営んでいた。二人はもともと同郷の仲間として義を結びながら、叔父と甥と呼び合う豪傑でもあった。鄒淵は「出林竜」、鄒潤は「独角竜」。二頭の竜が前後に並ぶその名は、登州の街道では知らぬ者がなかった。

独角竜という渾名には、特別な由来がある。頭に肉瘤と異様な骨の隆起があり、岩のように硬く、角のように突き出ていた。遠くからは一本角が生えているように見えたのである。これは外見が珍しいだけでなく、生まれつきの武器でもあった。硬い頭から繰り出す頭突きは凄まじく、両腕で抱えるほど太い青松を一撃で折ったこともある。まさしく鉄の骨だった。普通の喧嘩なら、頭をぶつけられた相手はたちまち倒れ、江湖にはその強さが知れ渡っていた。性格は率直でさっぱりしており、義と交情を重んじた。叔父と共に登雲山を守り、大いに名を馳せた。

梁山へ入るきっかけは、登州の牢破りだった。城外の猟師兄弟、解珍と解宝は、知府の命令で山へ虎狩りに行き、見事に仕留めた。ところが富豪の毛太公に手柄を奪われ、逆に強盗と訴えられて死刑囚の牢へ送られ、命を狙われた。従姉の母大虫、顧大嫂は登州で酒店を営む、気丈で義侠に富む女だった。身内の情を何より重んじ、冤罪を知ると夫の小尉遅、孫新と救出を相談し、孫新の兄で兵馬提轄を務める病尉遅、孫立も呼んだ。しかし数人だけで牢を破り官府に抗するのは難しい。孫新は登雲山へ赴き、鄒淵、鄒潤の叔父甥と、鉄叫子の楽和らを集めた。一同は心を合わせ、内外から呼応して登州の牢を破り、解珍と解宝を救い出し、毛太公の一家を皆殺しにして恨みを晴らした。事件が露見すると登州の八人には居場所がなくなり、兵をまとめて梁山へ向かった。鄒潤もこうして登雲山を離れた。

一党が梁山を頼った時、宋江は祝家荘への三度の攻撃に手を焼いていた。孫立は、荘の師範である欒廷玉が同門の兄弟弟子だと明かし、登州から鄆州の守備に移されたと偽って門を開かせ、内応する策を出した。宋江は喜んで採用した。鄒潤も官軍に扮して孫立らと荘へ入り、機を待った。梁山軍が総攻撃すると、一党は内部で寝返り、外の軍と呼応して祝家荘を大混乱に陥れ、ついに堅い守りを破った。鄒潤も勇戦して功を立て、この初仕事をもって正式に梁山の席を得たのである。

入山後の鄒潤は、一方面を単独で支える上将ではなかったが、身軽さと頭突きの技を備えた勇猛な副将だった。童貫を二度、高俅を三度破る大戦にも従い、ひるむことなく戦った。大集結で百八人の席次が定まると、地角星として第九十一位となり、鄒淵と前後に並んだ。叔父甥の二頭の竜がそろって地煞に列したことは、佳話として語られた。役目は軍の命に応じ、攻撃と守備に協力することだった。

招安後、鄒潤は遼へ北征し、田虎、王慶を討ち、南北のすべての戦いで力を尽くした。叔父とは常に行動を共にし、離れることがなかった。方臘討伐の江南の激戦では梁山の犠牲者が非常に多かったが、二人は幸い生き残って帰還し、地煞の将の中ではよい結末を得た者となった。凱旋後、鄒潤にも朝廷の恩賞と官職を受ける道はあった。しかし江湖の自由に慣れ、仕官にも文書仕事の束縛にも心が向かなかったため、功名を辞して鄒淵と登州の登雲山へ戻り、山林の気ままな暮らしに帰った。山賊時代から登州の牢破り、祝家荘の武功、南北の遠征、そして功を立てた後の引退まで、鄒潤は叔父と進退を共にして見捨てなかった。その情義は生涯を貫いている。江南で戦死した兄弟たちに比べ、無事に故山へ隠れた独角竜は、梁山好漢の中でも円満な幕引きを迎えたといえよう。

邹渊者，莱州人氏也，乃登州地面上的一条好汉。其人平日不务生理，专一爱赌钱、好使枪.en:
Zou Yuan came from Laizhou and became a hero of the Dengzhou region. Uninterested in an ordinary livelihood, he loved gambling and practicing with spear and staff, befriended fugitives, and gathered followers as an outlaw on Mount Dengyun in Shandong. There he raided households. Imposing in build, upright, fierce, and ready to kill or risk his life in battle, he earned the name Forest-Emerging Dragon. It described the unstoppable force of his attacks, like a mighty dragon bursting from the woods. His nephew Zou Run, the One-Horned Dragon, stayed constantly beside him and shared his outlaw life. Zou Run had a lump on his head and had once broken a great tree with a headbutt, making him another formidable fighter.

Their journey to Liangshan began with a prison rescue. A white-browed tiger with fierce eyes was killing people in the Dengzhou mountains, and the prefect ordered local hunters to destroy it by a fixed deadline. The brothers Xie Zhen and Xie Bao accepted the written order, set bow traps with poisoned arrows, and struck the tiger. Wounded, it rolled down the slope into the rear garden of Elder Mao's manor. When the brothers asked for its body, Mao coveted the official credit and reward. He denied their claim and instead accused them of daylight robbery and violence at his home. Colluding with Dengzhou's military superintendent and bribing officials, he had them arrested, tortured into a false confession, and placed on death row, determined to see them killed.

Their cousin Gu Dasao, the Tigress, ran an inn in Dengzhou. Fierce and chivalrous, she valued family deeply. Hearing that the brothers were wrongly imprisoned and in mortal danger, she planned a jail break with her husband Sun Xin, the Little Yuchi. He warned that their few people might not succeed and proposed calling Zou Yuan and Zou Run down from Dengyun. The couple already knew both men well and trusted their courage. Sun Xin went personally to the mountain and explained the brothers' plight. Zou Yuan agreed without hesitation and brought Zou Run and their followers down to help. They also enlisted Sun Xin's elder brother Sun Li, the Sickly Yuchi and Dengzhou's military inspector, together with Yue He, the Iron Whistle, and other heroes. Combining their efforts, they broke the prison, freed Xie Zhen and Xie Bao, and killed Elder Mao's entire household in revenge for the injustice. Zou Yuan fought at the front and contributed greatly.

After the prison break, the heroes had nowhere to stay and agreed to seek refuge at Liangshan. At the time its attacks on Zhu Family Manor had stalled. Sun Li and the manor's instructor Luan Tingyu were former fellow students, so Sun Li devised a false surrender and led his companions inside as agents. Zou Yuan and Zou Run entered with Sun Li, Gu Dasao, and the others. When Liangshan attacked, they turned on the defenders from within and coordinated with the army outside, bringing down the manor. Uncle and nephew fought bravely and earned distinction. They then accompanied the group to Liangshan and became chiefs.

At the grand assembly, Zou Yuan took the ninetieth seat among the Earthly Fiends as the Earthly Short Star. He served as an infantry officer available for orders. Zou Run also ranked among the Earthly Fiends, placing uncle and nephew together at Liangshan. Skilled with spear and staff and willing to charge into battle, Zou Yuan was a courageous infantry chief who generally worked beside his nephew in sieges and open fighting.

After the amnesty, Zou Yuan fought for Song Jiang against Liao, Tian Hu, and Wang Qing, never shrinking from campaigns across north and south. Fang La's terrible war killed or wounded more than half the Liangshan chiefs, but Zou Yuan survived the fighting in Jiangnan, one of the few to return alive. When the army came back after victory, he received a military appointment. Yet long hardship and the sight of fallen brothers had changed him, and he did not wish to endure the turmoil of official life. He surrendered his commission, returned to the Dengzhou countryside, and lived with Zou Run as an ordinary law-abiding man for the rest of his years. The Forest-Emerging Dragon had moved from outlawry on Dengyun to the Dengzhou prison rescue, joined Liangshan after saving the Xie brothers, and fought in every direction. He finally withdrew after success and died peacefully at home. Amid the many sorrows and few joys of Water Margin's endings, his was a rare safe return.
邹渊者，莱州人氏也，乃登州地面上的一条好汉。其人平日不务生理，专一爱赌钱、好使枪.ja:
鄒淵は萊州の出身で、登州一帯に名を知られた好漢だった。普段はまっとうな生業に励まず、賭博と槍棒の稽古を好み、江湖の無頼の者と交わっていた。山東の登雲山で手下を集めて山賊となり、人家を襲った。堂々たる体格で、性格は率直かつ勇猛、戦場では命を懸けて敵へ向かった。その強さを見た人々は「出林竜」と呼んだ。ひとたび暴れ出して突進すれば、林から現れる猛竜のように止めがたいという意味である。甥には「独角竜」の鄒潤がおり、二人はいつも離れず、登雲山でも行動を共にしていた。鄒潤は頭に瘤があり、一度の頭突きで大木を折ったこともある、やはり勇猛な男だった。

叔父甥が梁山へ入る発端は、一件の牢破りだった。登州の山に白い額と鋭い目を持つ虎が出て人を害したため、知府は猟師たちに期限を切って退治を命じた。解珍、解宝の兄弟は公文を受け、山に仕掛け弓と毒矢を置いて虎を射た。ところが手負いの虎は斜面を転げ落ち、麓の毛太公の屋敷の裏庭へ入ってしまった。兄弟が死骸を返すよう求めると、官府の褒賞を独占したい毛太公は知らぬふりをし、逆に白昼の強盗と押し込みだと訴えた。登州の兵馬都監と結託し、役人を買収して二人を捕らえ、拷問で虚偽の自白をさせ、死刑囚の牢へ送った。何としても命を奪うつもりだったのである。

冤罪の兄弟が命の危機にあると知った従姉の母大虫、顧大嫂は、夫の小尉遅、孫新と救出を相談した。登州で酒店を営む顧大嫂は、気性が激しく侠気に富み、身内の情を何より大切にしていた。孫新は、自分たちだけでは難しいので、登雲山の鄒淵、鄒潤を呼んで助けてもらおうと言った。夫婦は以前から二人と親しく、その勇敢さを知っていたのである。孫新は自ら山へ登り、解珍と解宝が不当に投獄された経緯を詳しく話した。鄒淵はためらわず承諾し、鄒潤と手下を率いて救援に下りた。さらに孫新の兄で登州の兵馬提轄、病尉遅の孫立や、鉄叫子の楽和らも加わった。一同は力を合わせて牢を破り、兄弟を救い出し、毛太公の一家を殺して冤罪の恨みを晴らした。鄒淵は勇敢に先頭へ立ち、大いに働いた。

牢破りの後、居場所を失った好漢たちは梁山へ向かうことを決めた。当時、梁山勢は祝家荘への攻撃を阻まれていた。孫立は荘の師範、欒廷玉と同門の兄弟弟子だったため、偽って降り、内応する策を立てた。鄒淵と鄒潤も孫立、顧大嫂らと荘内へ潜り込む。梁山軍が攻め寄せると、内部から寝返って外の軍と呼応し、祝家荘を大破した。叔父甥はこの戦いでも勇戦して功を立て、その後、一同と梁山へ入り、頭領となった。

大集結で天罡地煞の席次が定まると、鄒淵は地短星として第九十位に列した。地煞の一員として歩軍の将校を務め、命令に応じて働いた。鄒潤も地煞に入り、叔父甥はそろって梁山に名を連ねた。鄒淵は槍棒を得意とする勇敢な歩軍頭領で、攻城戦でも野戦でも、多くは甥と共に力を尽くした。

招安後、鄒淵は宋公明に従って遼、田虎、王慶と戦い、南北を転戦しても退くことはなかった。方臘討伐の激戦では梁山頭領の半数以上が死傷したが、鄒淵は江南の各地を戦い抜き、生還した数少ない好漢の一人となった。方臘平定後、帰還して武官の職を授けられたものの、長い苦難と兄弟たちの死を目にし、官界の波乱にも煩わされたくないと考えた。そこで官の辞令を返し、登州の郷里へ戻り、鄒潤と共に良民として余生を終えたのである。登雲山の山賊から登州の牢破りへ、解氏兄弟の救出から梁山への帰順へと歩み、各地を戦った出林竜は、最後に功を成して退き、故郷で穏やかに生涯を閉じた。悲しみが多く喜びの少ない水滸の結末の中では、無事に身を引けた貴重な一人だった。
